realReadableStart: Pickman's Model: You needn't think I'm crazy, Eliot--plenty of others have queerer prejudices than this. Why don't you laugh at Oliver's grandfather, who won't ride in a motor? If I don't like that damned subway, it's my own business; and we got here more quickly anyhow in the taxi. We'd have had to walk up the hill from Park Street...
realReadableEnd: r that monster. That last scare had come while I was reaching to uncurl it, and it seems I had vacantly crumpled it into my pocket. But here's the coffee--take it black, Eliot, if you're wise. Well--that paper wasn't a photograph of any background, after all. What it showed was simply the monstrous being he was pain...
